items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton addresses speculation around Ferrari "trust" issues
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿针对法拉利“信任”问题进行回应
这位七届F1冠军在最近几轮比赛中多次无视维修区叫停
刘易斯·汉密尔顿坚称在法拉利没有“信任”问题，尽管他在最近的几场F1大奖赛中对战略决策的否决已成为常态
这位七届世界冠军在最近四轮中的两轮比赛中——新加坡和巴西——忽视了进站维修的叫停，但这两次都给斯库德利亚车手带来了负面影响。
在新加坡，他选择在虚拟安全车下保持轨道位置，但由于轮胎磨损，他在比赛后期从领奖台争夺者降至第六位——对此他在赛后表示了歉意。
在上次巴西的比赛中，尽管雨势加大，汉密尔顿仍然坚持使用干胎，这导致他在最后一圈发生打滑，并在下一圈进站维修，最终排名第九。
这些事件发生在法拉利内部关系紧张的话题中，但在本周末的拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前，汉密尔顿确认一切顺利——尤其是他与2026年新任赛车工程师卡洛·桑蒂的关系。
‘这绝对不是信任问题，我们一直在努力改善沟通，’这位41岁的车手说。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
“今年情况好多了。卡洛做得非常出色，尤其是那两次，尤其是最后一次，只是我没有得到我需要的信息。”
“我在最后一刻接到了电话。我们将继续完善流程。我们在正在有效运作、正确方向的事情上非常团结。”
“今年对汉密尔顿来说有了很大的提升，他在积分榜上排名第四，还有三轮比赛剩余，目前积261分，比2025年的总和156分多了105分。”
他的第一个法拉利车队赛季确实令人失望，但尽管与上个赛季相比有显著提升，2026年仍然有一些改进的迹象。
这不仅是指战略决策，还包括他与队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔的关系，他们在几次比赛中发生冲突，最值得注意的是三周前的墨西哥站。
这导致法拉利失去了胜利，之后汉密尔顿批评了勒克莱尔的“孤注一掷”态度，并在圣保罗表示摩纳哥人对他比对其他车手的压力更大。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
这导致了双方Scuderia车手以及车队老板Fred Vasseur和汉密尔顿、勒克莱尔之间长达一个小时的会议，现在他们相信问题已经得到解决。
‘查尔斯是一位伟大的车手，’汉密尔顿说。‘关于像关闭挡风玻璃罩这样的细节，我们的讨论非常明确，我们彼此理解，我们理解彼此的界限和最终目标，那就是为车队取得最佳成绩。’
“所以我不觉得那会是个问题。我对与他比赛没有担忧或顾虑，我也不认为他会对我有顾虑。”
“关于墨西哥碰撞的讨论自然是热烈的，但勒克莱尔认为那是为法拉利驾驶的结果，现在所有的焦点都集中在确保车队在制造商排名中取得第二名。”
“一切都被夸大了，”勒克莱尔说。 “我已经习惯了，因为这么多年来一直在为法拉利赛车。但事情往往被夸大了。
“目标并不总是要达成一致，这永远不会发生。我们可以有不同的观点，比如在墨西哥就是这样。"
“但仅仅是说话就缓解了所有的紧张，我们对此完全没问题。并不是因为我们不得不聊一个小时，尽管最后聊了一个小时，只是因为我们过得愉快。"
“我们开始谈论许多其他事情，试图帮助团队前进，帮助车队前进。"
“但是关于紧张的讨论可能只有五到十分钟，然后气氛就变得很轻松，就这样了。”
法拉利以95分的优势领先第三名的红牛，落后142分于在Interlagos赢得第九个冠军的梅赛德斯。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton addresses speculation around Ferrari "trust" issues
The seven-time F1 champion has defied pitstop calls on multiple occasions across recent rounds
Lewis Hamilton has insisted there are zero “trust” problems at Ferrari despite him overruling strategic calls becoming a repeated occurrence across recent Formula 1 grands prix.
The seven-time world champion has ignored calls to pit in two of the last four rounds - Singapore and Brazil - with both backfiring on the Scuderia driver.
In Singapore he elected to keep track position under a virtual safety car, but on worn tyres he dropped from podium contention to sixth late on - for which he apologised afterwards.
Then in Brazil last time out, Hamilton stayed on slicks despite the rain intensifying and this led to a late spin at the final corner before pitting the following lap to eventually finish ninth.

Those instances came amid talk of fractious relations down at Ferrari but ahead of this weekend’s Las Vegas Grand Prix, Hamilton confirmed all is well - particularly with his new-for-2026 race engineer Carlo Santi.
“It’s definitely not a trust thing, we’re constantly working on our communication,” said the 41-year-old.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
"It's been a lot better this year. Carlo has done an amazing job and those particular two times, particularly the last time, was just I didn't have the information I needed.
“I got the call right at the last minute. We'll just continue to work on the processes. We're super united in what's working, in the right direction."
This year has been much improved for Hamilton, who is fourth in the standings with three rounds remaining, currently on 261 points compared to his total of 156 in 2025.
His first year in Ferrari colours was certainly underwhelming, but there have still been signs of improvement in 2026 despite it being a significant jump from last season.
Not only is that in reference to the strategic calls, but also his connection with team-mate Charles Leclerc, clashing on a few occasions and most notably in Mexico three weeks ago.
It cost Ferrari the win and Hamilton subsequently criticised Leclerc’s “do or die” attitude, before suggesting in Sao Paulo that the Monegasque races him harder than he does with other drivers.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
That led to an hour-long meeting between both Scuderia drivers plus team boss Fred Vasseur and Hamilton and Leclerc are now confident that the issue has been resolved.

“Charles is a great driver,” said Hamilton. “The detail we went into about stuff like that, in terms of when we close the visor, it's very clear, we understand each other, we understand each other's boundaries and the ultimate goal, which is to get the best result for the team.
“So I don't feel like that will be a problem moving forward. I have no concerns or worries about racing him, and I don't think he does for me either.”
The talk surrounding the Mexico clash was naturally high, but Leclerc reckons that is a consequence of driving for Ferrari and all focus is now on securing runner-up in the constructors’ standings.
“Everything has been taken out of proportion,” said Leclerc. “I'm kind of used to it now, driving for Ferrari for so many years. But things are very often taken out of proportion.
“The goal is not always to agree and that will never happen. We can have different opinions and that was the case, for example, in Mexico.

“But just the fact of speaking eased all tensions and we were completely fine with it. It's not that we had to speak for an hour, even though it ended up lasting an hour, just because we had a good time.
“We started speaking about many other things in trying to bring the team and to help the team go forward.
“But the discussion about the tension was like maybe five or 10 minutes and then the air was clean and that's it.”
Ferrari heads into the Vegas race 95 points ahead of third-placed Red Bull and 142 behind Mercedes, who clinched its ninth title at Interlagos.

items.originalTitle: Charles Leclerc on journalist ban: “I was surprised by the choice of words”
detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔对记者禁令表示：“我对用词的选择感到惊讶”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔就国际汽联对一名记者的禁令打破沉默，质疑了作者用词的选择
对于法拉利车迷来说。最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远处的比赛反应。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔并没有参与阻止一名资深的Formula 1记者进入维修区，他也不感兴趣于监管媒体——即使当头条变得有些个人化时。
在2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前面对媒体时，法拉利车手首次就国际汽联撤销《每日邮报》记者乔纳森·麦克埃voy赛季剩余三场比赛资格的决定发表了看法。
"我看了那篇文章；我对用词的选择感到相当惊讶，但除此之外，我没有什么可说的。", 勒克莱尔说。"至于处罚本身，显然我与此事毫无关系，对此我也没什么可说的。"
尽管他对专栏感到惊讶，勒克莱尔还是在常规媒体审查和麦克埃voy使用的特定措辞之间划了一条界限。
"我只想说的是，作为一级方程式车手，我认为我们已经习惯了这种批评。不是这种批评，而是批评本身和对批评者的批评，勒克莱尔澄清说。""记者的工作当然是要提出一些尖锐的问题，有时还要做一些棘手的标题。但我对用词的选择感到惊讶。"
争议始于麦克埃voy发表了一篇评论文章，回顾了墨西哥城大奖赛首圈勒克莱尔与法拉利车队队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿之间的接触，他在文中将勒克莱尔称为一个“狡猾的小杂种”。
国际汽联总经理阿尔贝托·维拉雷尔随后通知麦克埃voy，他的资格认证被暂停，适用于拉斯维加斯、卡塔尔和阿布扎比，尽管他预计将在2027赛季回归。确认这一处罚时，国际汽联发言人引用了2026年一级方程式世界锦标赛指南，指出媒体通行证是由管理机构单独发放的，并需要“最高标准的公平和专业性”。
在随后的专栏中宣布他的禁令时，麦克埃voy为自己的勒克莱尔言论辩护，称其为“轻松的”和“玩笑式的”，同时指责法拉利车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔“出卖”了他——将这位法国人描述为一个“胖乎乎的小人物”，他“不知所措”。没有证据将瓦瑟尔或法拉利与国际汽联的纪律处分联系起来。
暂停引发了立即的僵局。《每日邮报》宣布全面抵制F1赛事和新闻发布会的报道，称禁令为“严厉的”和“对新闻自由的史无前例且令人愤慨的攻击”。体育部门负责人克里斯·迪恩要求立即恢复麦克埃voy的职位，前F1巨头伯尼·埃克莱斯顿也发表了评论，称国际汽联的行动“完全疯狂”。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc on journalist ban: “I was surprised by the choice of words”
Charles Leclerc breaks his silence on the FIA ban of a journalist, questioning the writer's choice of words
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Charles Leclerc had no hand in getting a veteran Formula 1 reporter barred from the paddock, and he isn't interested in policing the press - even when the headlines get a little personal.

Addressing the media ahead of the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix, the Ferrari driver spoke for the first time about the FIA’s decision to revoke Daily Mail journalist Jonathan McEvoy’s accreditation for the remaining three rounds of the season.

"I saw the article; I was quite surprised by the choice of words, but apart from that I don’t have much to say," Leclerc said. "Then on the sanction itself, obviously I’ve got absolutely nothing to do with it, and I don’t have much to say about it."
Despite his surprise at the column, Leclerc drew a line between routine media scrutiny and the specific phrasing McEvoy used.

"The only thing I’ll say is that as Formula 1 drivers, I think we are used to this kind of criticism. Not this kind of criticism, but to criticism in general and to critics," Leclerc clarified. "It’s definitely the job of journalists to kind of ask the bad questions and do some of the tough headlines sometimes. But I was surprised with the choice of words."

The controversy began after McEvoy published an opinion piece reflecting on the opening-lap contact between Leclerc and Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the Mexico City Grand Prix, in which he referred to Leclerc as a "sneaky little b*****d".

FIA general manager Alberto Villarreal subsequently notified McEvoy that his accreditation was suspended for Las Vegas, Qatar, and Abu Dhabi, though he is expected to return for the 2027 season. Confirming the sanction, an FIA spokesperson cited the 2026 Formula 1 world championship guidelines, stating that media passes are issued at the governing body's sole discretion and require "the highest standards of fairness and professionalism".

In a follow-up column announcing his ban, McEvoy defended his remark about Leclerc as "light-hearted" and "joshing", while alleging that Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur had "grassed" on him - describing the Frenchman as a "tubby little nobody" who is "out of his depth". No evidence has linked Vasseur or Ferrari to the FIA’s disciplinary action.

The suspension triggered an immediate standoff. The Daily Mail announced a full boycott of F1 race and press conference coverage for the final triple-header, calling the ban "draconian" and "an unprecedented and outrageous attack on the freedom of the press". Head of Sport Chris Dean demanded McEvoy’s immediate reinstatement, and former F1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone also weighed in, calling the FIA's move "completely mad".

items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯 F1赞助商Anthropic在纳斯达克股票市场指数的首次公开募股使其市值达到1.5万亿美元，成为2026年最有价值的F1赞助商之一。以下是2026年11月19日市场开盘前，按估计市值排列的七个最有价值的F1赞助商。
items.originalTitle: The most valuable F1 sponsors in 2026: where does Anthropic rank?
detailZh: 威廉姆斯一级方程式车队赞助商Anthropic在纳斯达克股票市场指数的首次公开募股(IPO)使其市值达到1500亿美元，使其成为2026年赛场上最有价值的F1赞助商之一。
但是，与其他F1赞助商相比，它排名如何呢？
以下是2026年11月19日市场开盘前，根据估计市值排名的七个最有价值的F1赞助商列表。该列表排除了私有公司，估值以美元为单位。
微软在2026年1月宣布与梅赛德斯F1车队达成多年合作协议，科技公司不仅装饰了银箭赛车的车身，还在其队服上也占据了显眼的位置。微软产品最近出现的故障对其价值影响甚微。
谷歌的母公司Alphabet拥有庞大的估值。这家位于加州的科技公司向迈凯轮提供了众多标志，包括AI助手Gemini、Google Cloud、Android以及其更多产品在迈凯轮的品牌中有所体现。Alphabet在2026年6月达到了4.8万亿美元的高点，之后开始下跌——它在一天之内（10月29日）损失了5000亿美元。
沙特阿拉伯的石油和天然气巨头阿美石油公司自2024年开始成为阿斯顿·马丁的独家冠名赞助商，此前两年它一直是与Cognizant一起作为银石车队联合冠名赞助商。阿美石油公司也是F1、F2和F3的主要合作伙伴，与阿斯顿·马丁的合同签到2028年。
Meta赞助了梅赛德斯，使用Meta AI和消息应用WhatsApp。Meta AI于2025年底加入，WhatsApp和梅赛德斯于2023年底联手，这是一项多年的协议。
Anthropic从2026年开始赞助威廉姆斯车队。这家科技公司以其AI产品Claude最为知名，其IPO发生在对AI公司审查比以往任何时候都更严格的时期。英伟达、Alphabet和微软是其所有者之一。
梅赛德斯与电脑组件制造商高级微设备公司自2020年以来签订了为期多年的合作协议。当时，AMD的市值刚刚超过1000亿。自那时起，硅谷公司的估值大幅上升，人工智能是其主要推动力。
总部位于旧金山的信用卡支付服务公司Visa与金融科技公司CashApp共同赞助小红牛车队，但两家公司并无关联。Visa自2024年起成为AlphaTauri的冠名合作伙伴，并在2026年通过与青训车队和高级车队签订小红牛合作协议，将合作延长至2030年。
与这些赞助商相比，每支F1车队的平均估值约为36亿美元，但在法拉利的案例中高达65亿美元（福布斯，2025年）——而F1本身的估值约为280亿美元。
F1本身拥有阿美石油公司作为全球合作伙伴，同时也是亚马逊网络服务（AWS）的全球人工智能合作伙伴。亚马逊的市值为2.78万亿美元，位列榜单第三。
全球市值最大的公司是苹果公司（市值51万亿美元），其Apple TV服务在美国提供一级方程式赛事的直播。
detailEn: Williams Formula 1 sponsor Anthropic’s Initial Public Offering (IPO) on the NASDAQ stock market index gives it a market capitalisation of $1.5 trillion USD - making it one of the most valuable F1 sponsors on the grid in 2026.
But how does it rank compared to other F1 sponsors?

Here are the seven most valuable F1 sponsors in terms of estimated market cap, before markets opened on November 19, 2026 - when Anthropic filed for its IPO. The list omits privately held companies, and valuations are in USD.

Microsoft announced a multi-year partnership with the Mercedes F1 team in January 2026, with the technology company adorning the Silver Arrows’ cars and taking a prominent spot on its teamwear too. Recent outages across Microsoft's products have done little to dent its value.

Google’s parent company Alphabet carries a towering valuation. The California-based tech company lends numerous logos to McLaren with AI assistant Gemini, Google Cloud, Android, and more of its products featuring on McLaren’s branding. Alphabet reached a peak of $4.8tn in June 2026 before falling - it lost $500bn in one day (October 29).

Saudi Arabian oil and gas giant Aramco has been Aston Martin’s sole title sponsor since the start of 2024, after two years of being the Silverstone’s team joint title sponsor alongside Cognizant. Aramco - which is also a major partner of F1, F2, and F3 - is signed with Aston Martin until 2028.
Meta sponsors Mercedes, using Meta AI and messaging app WhatsApp. Meta AI joined in late 2025 while WhatsApp and Mercedes joined forces in late 2023, in a multi-year deal.

Anthropic began sponsoring Williams in 2026. The tech company is best known for its AI product Claude and its IPO came at a time when scrutiny over AI companies is sharper than ever. Nvidia, Alphabet and Microsoft are among its owners.

Mercedes and computer component maker AMD (Advanced Micro Devices) have partnered in a multi-year deal since 2020. Back then, AMD’s market cap was just over $100bn. The Silicon Valley company’s valuation has shot up since then, with AI being its primary catalyst.

San Francisco-based card payment services company Visa shares title sponsorship of Racing Bulls with financial tech company CashApp, but the two companies are unrelated. Visa began as title partner of AlphaTauri in 2024 and, in 2026, it renewed its deals with the junior and senior F1 teams with the Racing Bulls partnership to continue “through to 2030”.
Compared to those sponsors, each F1 team is valued at an average of $3.6bn but up to $6.5bn in Ferrari’s case (Forbes, 2025) - while F1 itself is valued at around $28bn USD.
F1 itself boasts Aramco as a global partner, but also AWS - Amazon Web Services - as its global AI partner. Amazon's market cap of $2.78tn would put it third on this list.
The biggest company in the world by market cap is Apple ($5.1tn) whose Apple TV service carries F1 streaming in the United States.

detailZh: 拉斐尔·卡马拉在F2争冠与代表哈斯参加更多F1比赛之间两难
卡马拉、哈斯和法拉利需要就他在卡塔尔和阿布扎比的赛程做出关键决定
拉斐尔·卡马拉正面临抉择：是完成他争冠的F2赛季，还是代表哈斯车队跑完2026赛季剩余的F1比赛。
这位法拉利青训车手是卫冕F3冠军，作为新秀效力Invicta Racing并领跑F2积分榜，凭借本赛季的出色表现，他已拿下五个杆位、七次主赛领奖台，其中包括三场胜利。
埃斯特班·奥康与哈斯车队的决裂为卡马拉提供了在巴西大奖赛完成F1首秀的机会，而本周末在拉斯维加斯他将获得更多经验，为2027年随队完整的新秀赛季做准备。
然而，F2赛季最后两轮将与F1在卡塔尔和阿布扎比同期举行，因此卡马拉、哈斯和法拉利现在必须做出艰难抉择——这位年轻车手表示，“多方人士”将参与决策。
当被问及这一情况时，这位21岁的车手回答道：“嗯，这是个很好的问题。两者对我都非常重要。在F2，我觉得你全年都在为此努力，当然希望以高光收尾。而且，如果没有今年在F2与Invicta车队发生的一切，我也不会处于这个位置或拥有这些机会。所以，这肯定会非常特别。
“归根结底，我都会做我热爱的事，无论做哪一项我都会很开心。但对我而言，这肯定会是一个艰难的决定，因为一方面，你拥有F1，这是你一生都梦想成为和从事的事业；另一方面，你拥有整个锦标赛，你全年都在努力以圆满结束。”
“让我们看看。我现在会努力专注于这个周末，以好的方式结束。然后希望我们能解决问题，之后会发生什么再看。”
有趣的是，国际汽联（FIA）的规定意味着没有车手能在同一个周末同时参加F1和F2；如果卡马拉确实要参加这个青训系列赛，哈斯可以求助于储备车手平川亮，他在奥康突然被解雇后于墨西哥意外完成了大奖赛首秀。
尽管他目前领跑F2积分榜，这位Invicta车手仅领先红牛青训车手尼古拉·措洛夫七分，后者已无缘2027年随小红牛（小红牛）晋升F1。阿尔派青训成员亚历克斯·邓恩和加布里埃莱·米尼分别落后18分和44分。
当被Motorsport.com问及F2冠军对他的履历和职业生涯有多大价值时，卡马拉评论道：“是的，我认为那会很好，完成F2赛季。当然，当你回顾你在青训组别中取得的成就时，我认为那是非常美好的事情，拥有F3和F2冠军，作为新秀获胜。不仅如此，获胜和做事的感觉会非常棒。”
“但我仍然不知道会发生什么，也不知道我会怎么做。就像我说的，我只想先完成这个周末，之后肯定会有很多事情要讨论。”
哈斯的新车手在第二场大奖赛前感觉自信多了，他在因特拉戈斯赛道棘手的湿地条件下获得了关键经验，最终仅列第20名。
“主要的收获是与车队合作以及赛车表现方面的经验，”卡马拉在谈到自己作为赛车手的首次出场时说。“我认为这让你在本周末开始时就平静得多，因为某种程度上你知道会发生什么。
“这有助于你在周末开始时脑子里装的事情更少，这样你可以某种程度上更专注于细节，更专注于其他事情。可能在巴西时，你只是想同时学习所有东西，你的大脑开始有点过热。这肯定有帮助。”
detailEn: Rafael Camara torn between his F2 title bid and more F1 races with Haas
Camara, Haas and Ferrari have a crucial decision to make for his schedule in Qatar and Abu Dhabi
Rafael Camara is torn between completing his title-contending Formula 2 campaign and seeing out the 2026 season at Haas in Formula 1.

The Ferrari protege is the reigning F3 champion and leads the F2 standings as a rookie with Invicta Racing, courtesy of a starring campaign in which he has taken five pole positions and seven feature race podiums including three victories.

Esteban Ocon’s fallout with Haas has provided Camara with an opportunity to make his F1 debut at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and he will gain more experience this weekend in Las Vegas ahead of his full rookie campaign with the team in 2027.

However, the last two rounds of the F2 season are taking place alongside F1 in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, so Camara, Haas and Ferrari now have a tough call to make – with the youngster indicating “a mix of people” will be involved in the decision-making.

Asked about the situation, the 21-year-old replied: “Well, that's a very good question. Both of them will be very important for me. In F2, I feel like the whole year you're working for that and for sure you want to finish in a high. And also, I wouldn't be in this position or having the opportunities if it didn't happen, what happened this year in F2 with Invicta. So, for sure, it would be very special.

“At the end of the day, I'll be doing what I love to do, and I'll be happy in doing [either] of them. But it will definitely be a difficult decision to do on my side, because one side, you have Formula 1, something you've always been dreaming of being and doing in your life; and the other side, you have the whole championship and you're working the whole year to close that.
“Let's see. I'll try now to focus on this weekend and finish in a good way. And then hopefully we can sort it out, what will happen after that.”

Interestingly, FIA regulations mean no driver can compete in both F1 and F2 on the same weekend; if Camara does race in the feeder series, Haas can resort to reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa, who made an unexpected grand prix debut in Mexico after Ocon was suddenly dismissed.

Though he currently leads the F2 standings, the Invicta racer is just seven points ahead of Red Bull junior Nikola Tsolov, who has missed out on a 2027 F1 graduation with Racing Bulls. Alpine academy members Alex Dunne and Gabriele Mini are respectively 18 and 44 points adrift.

Asked by Motorsport.com how valuable the F2 title would be to his CV and career, Camara commented: “Yeah, I think that would be nice, finishing the F2 season. And for sure, when you [look back on] what you achieved on the junior categories, I think it's something very nice, having the F3 and F2 championship, winning as a rookie. Not only that, but the feeling of winning and doing things will be very nice.
“But I still don't know what will happen and I don't know how I will do it. Like I said, I'm just trying to finish this weekend and then for sure there will be a lot of things to discuss after.”
Haas’ new driver is feeling much more confident ahead of his second grand prix, having gained key experience in tricky wet conditions on his way to a lowly 20th at Interlagos.

“The main takeaways were working with the team and also with how the car behaves,” Camara said of his maiden outing as a race driver. “I think it makes you already starting this weekend much calmer, because in a way you know what to expect.

“It helps starting the weekend with less things in your head, so you can, in a way, focus more into details, more in other things. Probably in Brazil, you're just trying to learn everything at the same time and your brain starts to overheat a bit. For sure it helps.”

items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc believes the reaction to his clash with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the Mexico Grand Prix was "taken out of proportion". The lap-one collision at Turn 4 saw both outbrake themselves and cost Ferrari a straightforward victory, which went to Max Verstappen.
detailZh: 勒克莱尔称墨西哥站与汉密尔顿碰撞反应被夸大
勒克莱尔与法拉利队友汉密尔顿在墨西哥首圈发生碰撞，两人因此将胜利拱手让给维斯塔潘
查尔斯·勒克莱尔认为，外界对他与一级方程式队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥大奖赛上的碰撞反应“被夸大了”。
三周前在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道，勒克莱尔在首圈进攻杆位起步的汉密尔顿，导致两人在4号弯双双冲出刹车点，法拉利因此错失一场本可轻松拿下的胜利。
红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘获胜，而汉密尔顿批评了队友“要么拼要么死”的态度，随后暗示勒克莱尔对他的对抗比对他人的对抗更激烈。
随后巴西站围绕这一戏剧性事件的讨论自然非常热烈，尤其是因为法拉利是F1最大的车队，但在本周末拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前，紧张气氛似乎已经平息。
“一切都被夸大了，”勒克莱尔说道，他自2019年起为法拉利效力，比汉密尔顿加入早了六年。
“为法拉利效力这么多年，我现在有点习惯了。但事情经常被夸大。”
“目标并不总是要达成一致，而这也永远不会发生。我们可以有不同的意见，情况确实如此，例如在墨西哥。
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
“但仅仅是交谈这一事实就缓解了所有紧张情绪，我们对此完全没问题。并不是说我们非得谈上一个小时，尽管最后确实持续了一个小时，只是因为我们聊得很愉快，还开始谈到许多其他事情，试图把车队凝聚起来，帮助车队向前迈进。
“但关于紧张关系的讨论大概只有五到十分钟，然后气氛就清朗了，就这样。”
汉密尔顿对此表示赞同，称“我不觉得这会是未来前进道路上的问题”，并表示“我对他没有任何顾虑或担忧”，此前两人在圣保罗都与车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔进行了交谈。
“弗雷德肯定参与了，因为他在会上，而且是他组织了这次会议，”勒克莱尔透露。
“所以我们三个人在一起，是的，讨论进行得非常顺利。但正如我们所说，我认为非常、非常快，我们只需要谈一谈。
“而且几句话之后，原本存在的紧张气氛就已经消失了，一切都很好。然后双方都朝着在制造商[锦标赛]中获得第二名的方向努力。”
“车队积分榜第二的位置很重要。确实我们身后有相对较大的差距，但这并不意味着我们需要去缩小它。
“我们仍然必须作为一个团队去努力。但现在对我来说真正重要的是，努力在赛季结束前赢下比赛，赢得一场大奖赛。”
2026赛季现在还剩三场大奖赛，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿今年都只有一场胜利，而法拉利领先第三名红牛95分。
这支奥地利车队在赛季后期状态回升，很大程度上要归功于其在巴库带来的升级，维斯塔潘自那之后已经三次获胜，但红牛缩小差距并不会让勒克莱尔对墨西哥站感到后悔。
这位九次分站冠军得主表示：“我会继续竭尽全力，努力为车队带来尽可能最好的成绩。作为车手，我只想尽可能多地赢得胜利。”
detailEn: F1 Mexico GP fallout was “taken out of proportion” - Charles Leclerc
Leclerc and Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton clashed on lap one in Mexico, causing both to lose victory to Max Verstappen
Charles Leclerc believes the reaction to his clash with Formula 1 team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the Mexico Grand Prix was “taken out of proportion”.
The Scuderia lost a straightforward victory at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez three weeks ago after Leclerc attacked polesitter Hamilton on lap one, leading to both outbraking themselves at Turn 4.
Red Bull’s Max Verstappen emerged victorious while Hamilton criticised his team-mate’s “do or die” attitude, before suggesting that Leclerc races him harder than he does with others.

Talk surrounding the drama at the following race in Brazil was naturally high, particularly with Ferrari being F1’s biggest team, but tensions have seemingly now died ahead of this weekend’s Las Vegas Grand Prix.
“Everything has been taken out of proportion,” said Leclerc, who has driven for Ferrari since 2019, six years before Hamilton joined.
“I'm kind of used to it now, driving for Ferrari for so many years. But things are very often taken out of proportion.
“The goal is not always to agree and that will never happen. We can have different opinions and that was the case, for example, in Mexico.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

“But just the fact of speaking eased all tensions and we were completely fine with it. It's not that we had to speak for an hour, even though it ended up lasting an hour, just because we had a good time and we started speaking about also many other things in trying to bring the team and to help the team go forward.
“But the discussion about the tension was like maybe five or 10 minutes and then the air was clean and that's it.”

Hamilton echoed those sentiments claiming “I don't feel like that will be a problem moving forward”, as “I have no concerns or worries about racing him” after both held talks with team boss Fred Vasseur in Sao Paulo.
“Fred was definitely involved as he was in the meeting and he organised the meeting,” revealed Leclerc.
“So we were all three together and, yeah, the discussion went very well. But as we've said, I think very, very quickly, we only had to speak.

“And after a few sentences, already the tension that was there was not there anymore and it was all fine. Then to both work in the direction of having that second place in the constructor [championship].
“The second place in the constructor is important. It's also true that we've got a relatively big margin behind, which doesn't mean we need to minimise that.
“We still have to work as a team. But what is really important for me now is to try and win before the end of the season and win a race.”
There are now three grands prix remaining in 2026 with Leclerc and Hamilton both on just one victory for the year, while Ferrari is 95 points ahead of third-placed Red Bull.
The Austrian outfit has enjoyed a late resurgence, largely thanks to its Baku upgrades with Verstappen winning three times since, but Red Bull closing the gap doesn’t make Leclerc regret Mexico.
“I'll keep pushing as hard as I possibly can to try and bring the best possible result to the team,” said the nine-time race winner. “As a driver, I just want to win as much as possible.”

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克从阿尔派手中挖来斯金纳
items.summaryZh: 前红牛首席设计师克雷格·斯金纳在凯迪拉克的招募推动下放弃加盟阿尔派，于拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末前正式出任凯迪拉克首席开发工程师。
items.originalTitle: Ex-Red Bull hire Cadillac stole from Alpine finally joins
items.summaryEn: Former Red Bull chief designer Craig Skinner has officially joined Cadillac as chief development engineer ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend, after Cadillac's recruitment push persuaded him to drop his planned move to Alpine.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克从红牛挖来的克雷格·斯金纳终于开始为车队工作，此时距离凯迪拉克在夏天最后一刻阻止他加盟竞争对手阿尔派已过去三个月。
斯金纳曾在红牛工作20年，最终担任首席设计师，他于周三在拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末前正式加入凯迪拉克，出任首席开发工程师。
他今年2月离开红牛并进入园艺假，之后原定于8月加盟阿尔派，甚至已在内部被宣布为新员工。
但在凯迪拉克更换车队管理层、由马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接替格雷姆·洛登担任车队领队后，新一轮招募工作包括说服斯金纳转而与红牛前车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在凯迪拉克重聚。
不过，凯迪拉克不得不等待他们想要的人，因为阿尔派用斯金纳自己合同中的离职条款留住了他，这意味着尽管他从未正式加入该车队，仍需经历三个月的离职期。
凯迪拉克多数股东TWG Motorsport的负责人丹·托里斯表示，佩雷斯一直在“利用他的人脉”为车队吸引人员的兴趣，并在寻找人才方面“发挥了关键作用”。
据了解，斯金纳就是一个明显的例子，因为佩雷斯非常希望凯迪拉克在招募方面采取积极进取的策略，并且据信早在几个月前就已将他确定为目标。
当《The Race》问及佩雷斯对凯迪拉克展现出能够如此行事、以这种方式从另一支车队挖走人才有多满意时，他只是微笑着说“我们合作得很好”。
斯金纳不会是凯迪拉克最高级别的技术负责人，尼克·切斯特才是首席技术官，但在宣布斯金纳加盟时，凯迪拉克表示，他的任务是在整个开发流程中提供技术方向，支持整车概念、空气动力学设计、分析与交付之间的衔接。
他入职之际恰逢另一位重要新援——新任空气动力学主管埃里克·布兰丁——首次在拉斯维加斯赛道现场亮相。
曾担任梅赛德斯和阿斯顿·马丁空气动力学主管的布兰丁已加入凯迪拉克，出任空气动力学主管；而曾效力于迈凯伦、红牛和法拉利的蒂姆·利恩将于2027年1月入职担任首席工程师，负责空气动力学建模与仿真，并向布兰丁汇报。
佩雷斯曾对凯迪拉克在他认为本应更早加强的领域缺乏招聘感到担忧；他相信，像这样的签约将迫使凯迪拉克提高标准。
当被《The Race》问及他预计这些人会对车队产生多大影响时，他说：“影响很大，因为那些人来了，他们在F1已经做了一切。”
“他们来这里只是因为想在一个不同的项目上证明自己。”
“我们都知道他们有多出色，但这是一个不同的项目，我们需要基本上开始把这种文化落实到位，把这些人安排到位，我认为他们会给当前的组织带来很多东西。”
“而且我认为，如果我们都足够聪明，我认为我们应该利用他们所有的经验，确保我们从他们身上榨取一切。”
detailEn: Cadillac’s ex-Red Bull recruit Craig Skinner has finally started working for the team three months after it stopped him from joining rival Alpine at the last minute in the summer.

Skinner, who had a 20-year stint at Red Bull culminating in the role of chief designer, officially joined Cadillac as chief development engineer on Wednesday ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend.
He left Red Bull in February and went on gardening leave, after which he was due to join Alpine in August and was even announced internally as a new hire.

But after Cadillac’s change of team management, with Marcin Budkowski replacing Graeme Lowdon as team principal, a new recruitment push included persuading Skinner to reunite with ex-Red Bull driver Sergio Perez at Cadillac instead.
Cadillac had to wait to get its man, though, as Alpine held Skinner to the exit terms of his own contract, which meant a three-month period of leave despite never starting with the team.

Dan Towriss, who heads up Cadillac’s majority owner TWG Motorsport, said Perez had been “using his network” to generate interest in the team from personnel and “been an instrumental part” in locating talent.
Skinner is understood to be a clear example of that, as Perez was very keen for Cadillac to be aggressive with its recruitment and is understood to have identified him as a target months earlier.

Perez only said “we all work well together” with a smile when asked by The Race how pleased he was that Cadillac had shown it was able to act as it did and poach someone from another team in such a manner.

Skinner will not be the most senior technical figure at Cadillac, where Nick Chester is chief technical officer, but when he was announced, Cadillac said he will be tasked with providing technical direction across the development process, supporting the connection between car concept, aerodynamic design, analysis and delivery.
His employment starting coincides with another major recruit - new aerodynamics head Eric Blandin - being trackside for the first time in Las Vegas.

Ex-Mercedes and Aston Martin aero chief Blandin has joined Cadillac as head of aerodynamics while Tim Lean - formerly of McLaren, Red Bull and Ferrari - will be chief engineer when he joins in January 2027, in charge of aerodynamics modelling and simulation, reporting to Blandin.
Perez has had concerns about Cadillac’s lack of recruitment in areas he felt should have been strengthened sooner; he believes signings like these will force Cadillac’s standards higher.
“A lot,” he said when asked by The Race how he expected them to impact the team, “because those guys are coming in, they've done everything in Formula 1.
“They're only here because they want to prove themselves on a different project.

“We all know how good they are, but this is a different project where we need to basically start putting this culture in place, these people in place, and I think they will be bringing a lot to the current organisation.
“And I think if we are all clever enough, I think we should use all their experience to make sure that we take everything out of them.”
keyPointsZh: 斯金纳在红牛工作20年，最终担任首席设计师，今年2月离队后进入园艺假。
他原定8月加盟阿尔派，甚至已在内部被宣布为新员工，但凯迪拉克更换车队管理层后说服他与塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在凯迪拉克重聚。
阿尔派按合同离职条款要求斯金纳履行三个月假期，因此他虽从未在阿尔派上岗，凯迪拉克仍须等待。
keyPointsEn: Skinner spent 20 years at Red Bull, culminating in the role of chief designer, and left the team in February before going on gardening leave.

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton: "You can't be the only one pushing for change" in F1
detailZh: 汉密尔顿："F1中不能只有一个人推动变革"
法拉利车手汉密尔顿表示他希望F1中的其他人能效仿他发声，并描述了他访问埃及加沙边境的经历
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
汉密尔顿表示他希望F1中的其他人能效仿他发声支持全球问题，但承认目前还没有人这么做。
七次世界冠军利用他的平台支持包括赛车运动中的多样性以及最近加沙地带的人道主义危机在内的各种事业。
在拉斯维加斯接受媒体采访时，这位英国人在本周末的比赛前夕被问及是否更多的人会在体育界使用他们的平台发声，他表示每个人都有权拥有自己的观点，但呼吁整个锦标赛做得更多。
“我只是尽力以有意的态度去领导，并希望我始终认为，如果你能成为那个引发涟漪的鹅卵石，鼓励其他人跟随你的脚步，但到目前为止情况并非如此。老实说，我不知道其他人代表什么，但这并不是我的关心所在，”汉密尔顿说。
“我的关注点只是尽力做到最好，坚持正确的事情，不管别人说什么。我只是跟随我的内心，我为与我基金会合作的工作感到非常自豪。”
汉密尔顿表示，F1正在朝着“积极的方向”发展，这得益于FIA、F1和车队签署的多元化宪章等项目，但他坚决认为，改变的责任不能仅仅落在一个人身上。
“我们还能做更多。这是一个价值超过200亿的大生意，不能只有一个人在推动变革和积极的事物。你们都需要共同努力。所以我希望越来越多的人能加入这个旅程，”他说。
汉密尔顿还谈到了他上周在圣保罗大奖赛两天后访问埃及的经历，当时他被带去参观了拉法赫口岸进入加沙的援助行动。
“我真的很想亲自去看看。与一个正在做一些了不起工作的组织合作，但那是非常令人心碎的，非常沉重。我遇到了一些被枪击、烧伤和毁容的孩子，”他说。
“但是看到有一些好人正在努力帮助这些年轻人恢复，给予他们教育，这真是太令人惊讶了。”
去年12月，与英国红十字会一起访问约旦的法拉利车手表示，维持对这些主题的报道非常重要。
“我认为世界上没有任何一个孩子应该对政府的决定负责，或者受到政府决定的影响。这真的是关于事情的人性方面。我们真正代表的是人性。而且只要我有这个平台，我就会继续这样做，”汉密尔顿结束说道。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: "You can't be the only one pushing for change" in F1
The Ferrari driver says he hoped others in Formula 1 would follow his lead in speaking out, and described what he saw on his trip to Egypt's border with Gaza
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Lewis Hamilton says he had hoped others in Formula 1 would follow his lead in speaking out on issues around the world, but admitted that "so far that's not the case".
The seven-time world champion has used his platform for causes including diversity in motorsport and, more recently, the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.

Asked by the media in Las Vegas ahead of this weekend's race whether more people in the sport be using their platforms to speak out, the  Briton said everyone was entitled to their own view, but called on the championship to do more as a whole.

"I just try to lead with intention and hope that, I've always thought, kind of, if you can be that pebble that creates a ripple and encourages other people to maybe follow in your footsteps but so far that's not the case. And honestly, I don't know what everyone else stands for, but that's not really my concern," Hamilton said.

"My concern is just trying to, as I said, try to do the best I can and stand for the right things, regardless of what people say. I just follow my heart, and I'm really proud of the work that I've done with my foundation."

Hamilton said F1 was moving "in a positive direction" with projects such as the diversity charter signed by the FIA, F1 and the teams, but is adamant that the responsibility of making a change could not fall on just one person.

"There's more we can do. It's a huge business, valued at over 20 billion. You can't be the only one pushing for change and positive things like that. You need to all work together. So I'm hoping more and more people will come along on the journey," he said.
Hamilton also spoke about his visit to Egypt last week, two days after the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, when he was shown the aid operation at the Rafah crossing into Gaza.

"I really wanted to go and see it for myself. Worked with an organisation that's doing some amazing work, but it was, you know, heartbreaking and very, very heavy. I met children that had been shot, and burned, and disfigured," he said.
"But it was amazing to see that there are some good people on the ground that are doing some really amazing work to try and help these youngsters recover, give them education."
The Ferrari ace who visited Jordan with the British Red Cross last December, said it was important to maintain coverage on these subjects.

"I think that no child in the world should ever be responsible for, or be affected by a government's decision. And it's really just about the human side of things. We really stand for humanity. And while I have this platform, I will continue to do that," Hamilton ended.

detailZh: 本田公布2027年F1动力单元关键变更
日本制造商为拉斯维加斯大奖赛引入了新的"对策"，但表示将为2027年开发新的电池结构
在圣保罗大奖赛之后，本田仍无法完全解释拉塞尔·斯特罗尔的退赛。加拿大车手被迫退赛14次，平了单赛季退赛次数最多的纪录
在拉斯维加斯大奖赛前，本田对电池故障进行了更多调查，首席工程师奥里哈拉在接受Motorsport.com采访时解释说："在巴西之后，我们对电池进行了检查，发现了一些预期中的问题。"
“这是一种可以预见的故障。我们以为我们为巴西赛事采取了对策，但那不足以防止电池问题发生。”
“然后对于这次赛事，我们带来了另一个对策以获得更好的可靠性。我无法解释具体的细节，但在巴西大奖赛之后，我们进行了检查并发现了问题所在。”
日本工程师立即补充说，他不清楚为拉斯维加斯引入的额外措施是否足以防止问题再次发生。”
“我们为这次赛事带来的对策可能，怎么说呢，并不能完全防止问题发生。我们仍然需要获得完整的图片和理解。”
奥伊哈拉还透露，电池将是本田明年将进行改变的领域之一。这家以樱花为基地的制造商将不再仅仅依赖对策，而是寻求从根本上解决问题。
Shintaro Orihara，本田赛车公司赛道总经理兼首席工程师
“但对于2027年，我们将更新电池内部结构以提高可靠性。我们仍在樱花进行相关工作，但他们意识到他们需要提高电池的可靠性以应对明年。”
“同时，我们还需要继续为今年带来对策，以确保良好的可靠性并在汽车上积累更多里程。”
'结构'这个词理论上可以指几个方面，但当被要求澄清时，本田确认它指的是'能量存储的内部结构，以增加鲁棒性和整体可靠性'。
在斯特罗尔在巴西退赛之前，这种改变的需要就已经很明显了，尽管オリハラ解释说，从最新的失败中吸取的教训仍然可以用来改进2027年的动力单元。
“对于我们的2027年电池，我们开发了另一种结构，但我们可以从今年遇到的问题中吸取一些东西来提高我们的可靠性。”
“所以这并不是直接导致2027年的改变，但在某些方面，我们可以从今年的可靠性中学习。这就是我们为什么不断采取对策来提高我们的可靠性。这也会帮助我们明年。”
之前的燃烧突破在2026年的规则下不再有效
虽然电池更换主要是为了提高可靠性，但在纯粹性能方面，本田的焦点仍然在于内燃机。
大原在接受Motorsport.com采访时已经解释过，如果内燃机的纯粹动力显著不足，那么提高能量管理或效率就没什么用了，这就是为什么这仍然是2027年的关键焦点。
费尔南多·阿隆索，阿斯顿·马丁车队，阿维德·林德布拉德，小红牛（小红牛）
首席工程师在拉斯维加斯承认，在当前的规定下，燃烧方式与之前有所不同，这意味着本田不能再使用之前周期中的一些经过验证的解决方案。这最初让制造商走上了错误的道路。
"在之前的规定下，我们发现了一种我们称之为快速燃烧的燃烧方式。这给了我们在那些规定下很多性能," 大矢承认。
"我们开始为今年进行开发，所以对于这个规定，我们也采用了快速燃烧，但后来我们意识到我们需要在快速燃烧的基础上进一步提高燃烧效率。
"现在我们仍在努力克服快速燃烧。这是我们目前和未来关注的重点。快速燃烧给我们带来了良好的性能，但有时管理燃烧本身是一项挑战。"
"在这个规则下，主要的区别是我们不再有气缸压力传感器。根据这个规则，我们需要找到一些其他的燃烧方式来获得更多的性能，这是我们正在努力改进的一个领域。"
"最后，大原承认本田在某些时候的绝对峰值功率达到了要求水平，但控制它并持续地提供它仍然特别具有挑战性。"
"如果我们有良好的控制，我们可以在更宽的范围内保持峰值功率。但如果我们没有良好的控制，我们只能得到峰值功率，但没有那个更宽的范围，扭矩输出或扭矩精度就会降低。所以，是的，我们需要在这个规则下提高燃烧控制和燃烧性能。"
detailEn: Honda reveals key F1 power unit change for 2027
The Japanese manufacturer has introduced a new "countermeasure" for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, but says it will develop a new battery structure for 2027

Immediately after the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, Honda was still unable to fully explain Lance Stroll's DNF. The Canadian was forced to retire for the 14th time, equalling the all-time record for the most retirements in a single Formula 1 season.

Ahead of the race weekend in Las Vegas, Honda has gathered more information about the battery failure, with chief engineer Shintaro Orihara explaining when asked by Motorsport.com about the problem: "After Brazil, we have done some inspection on the battery and we found, as expected, what happened.
"It's a kind of expected issue. We thought we applied a countermeasure for Brazil, but that was not enough to prevent a battery issue from happening.

"Then for this event, we brought another countermeasure to get better reliability. I can't explain the exact details of it, but after the Brazilian GP, we did the inspection and found out what happened."
The Japanese engineer immediately added that he was not sure whether the additional measure introduced for Las Vegas would be enough to prevent a repeat of the problem.
"The countermeasure we brought to this event will probably, how to say, not fully prevent it. We still need to get a complete picture and understanding."

Orihara also revealed that the battery will be one of the areas Honda changes for next year. The Sakura-based manufacturer will no longer rely solely on countermeasures, instead seeking to address the problem more fundamentally.
Shintaro Orihara, Honda Racing Corporation Trackside General Manager and Chief Engineer

"But for 2027, we will update the structure inside the battery to have better reliability. We're still working on it in Sakura, but they realised that they need to improve reliability of battery for next year.
"And we need to keep bringing countermeasures for this year as well, to have good reliability and to accumulate more mileage on the car."

The word 'structure' could theoretically refer to several aspects, but when asked for clarification, Honda confirmed that it concerns "the internal structure of the energy store to increase robustness and overall reliability".

The need for this change had already become apparent before Stroll's retirement in Brazil, although Orihara explained that the lessons learned from the latest failure can still be used to improve the 2027 power unit.
"For our 2027 battery, we developed another structure, but we can still learn something from this year's issue to improve our reliability.

"So it was not directly leading [to the change for 2027], but in some areas, we can learn from this year's reliability. That's why we keep bringing countermeasures to improve our reliability. That will help us for next year as well."
Previous combustion breakthroughs no longer work under 2026 rules
While the battery change is primarily intended to improve reliability, Honda's focus in terms of outright performance remains on the internal combustion engine.

Orihara has already explained in an interview with Motorsport.com that improving energy management or efficiency is of little use if the ICE is significantly lacking in outright power, which is why that remains the key focus for 2027.
Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin Racing, Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls

The chief engineer acknowledged in Vegas that combustion works somewhat differently under the current regulations than it did previously, meaning Honda could no longer use some of the tried-and-tested solutions from the previous cycle. This initially sent the manufacturer down the wrong path.
"Under the previous regulations, we found what we call rapid combustion. That gave us a lot of performance under those regulations," Orihara admitted.
"We started our development for this year, so for this regulation, with the rapid combustion as well, but then we realised that we needed to improve combustion further beyond the rapid combustion.

"Still now, we are on the way to overcome rapid combustion. That is what we are focusing on now and for the future. Rapid combustion gave us good performance, but sometimes it's challenging to manage the combustion itself.

"The main difference under this regulation is that we no longer have a cylinder pressure sensor. Under this regulation, we need to find some other combustion style to get more performance and that's an area we are working on to improve."
Finally, Orihara acknowledged that Honda's outright peak power is at the required level at times, but that controlling it and delivering it consistently remains particularly challenging.

"If we have good control, we can keep that peak power in a wider range. But if we don't have good control, we just get peak power, but without that wider range, there’s less torque delivery or torque accuracy. So yes, we need to improve combustion control and combustion performance under this regulation."

detailZh: 哈贾尔 惊讶地发现他最昂贵的交易卡以五位数的价格售出
红牛车手在 Topps 展示他签名的卡片时猜测了 3,000 美元，并在 35,000 美元时放弃
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
当 Topps 揭示了 哈贾尔 最有价值的交易卡售出价格时，红牛一级方程式车手 哈贾尔 愣住了。
卡片公司拍摄了这位法国人被展示一张带有三个红牛标志的签名卡，并要求他为这张卡定价。他立刻就认出来了，但他的第一个猜测有些偏离。
"我记得签过这张卡。我不知道，我不擅长这个，但可能是3千," 哈吉说。
被告知要定更高的价格，他逐渐将价格提高到1万美元、1.5万美元和2.5万美元，每一步都越来越不相信。
"好吧，我停在3.5万," 他说，然后尝试了5万美元，这太高了。他的最终猜测是4.3万美元，但还是比实际价格4.4万美元少了。
问他会对买家说什么，哈吉尔指向卡片上他签名旁边的信息：‘你真幸运！’
‘他自己在考虑签售一些自己的东西，’一位粉丝开玩笑说，另一位评论道：‘作为一个哈吉尔的收藏家，这太棒了！’
‘伊萨克，你不应该这么惊讶。相信我，世界上有很多（可能太多）人真的（可能太过于）喜欢你，’另一位粉丝写道，还有人也发帖说：‘他正在考虑把下一个请求他签名的卡片留给自己，然后自己卖掉。’
这段视频是在Fanatics Collectibles公司办公室拍摄的，Fanatics Collectibles是Topps的母公司，自2020年以来一直持有官方一级方程式交易卡许可。
自从那时起，一级方程式卡牌市场蓬勃发展，销量最大的仍然是那些知名明星。今年早些时候，Topps NOW卡牌上标记着刘易斯·汉密尔顿在巴塞罗那-加泰罗尼亚大奖赛上为法拉利赢得的第一场比赛，成为有史以来销量最高的F1 Topps NOW卡牌，印刷量超过50,000份。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar stunned as his most expensive trading card sells for five-figure sum
The Red Bull driver guessed $3,000 when Topps showed him the signed card, and gave up at $35,000
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Red Bull Formula 1 driver Isack Hadjar was left speechless when Topps revealed how much the most valuable of his trading cards had sold for.

The card company filmed the Frenchman being shown an autographed card carrying three Red Bull patches and asked him to put a price on it. He recognised it straight away, but his first guess was some way off.
"I remember signing this one. I don't know, I'm not good at this, but probably 3k," Hadjar said.
Told to aim higher, he worked his way up through $10,000, $15,000 and $25,000, growing more disbelieving with every step.
"OK, I stop at 35," he said, before trying $50,000, which was too high. His final guess of $43,000 left him just short of the real figure: $44,000.
Asked what he would say to the buyer, Hadjar pointed to the message he had written next to his signature on the card itself: "Lucky you!"
"He’s thinking about signing and selling some himself," one fan joked, while another commented: "As a Hadjar collector, this is awesome!"

"Isack, you shouldn’t be so surprised. Believe me, there are plenty of people in the world who really (perhaps too much) like you," another fan wrote, and someone else also posted: "He's thinking about pocketing the next one they ask him to sign and selling it himself."
The video was shot at the offices of Fanatics Collectibles, the parent company of Topps, which has held the official Formula 1 trading card licence since 2020.

F1 cards have boomed since then, and the biggest sellers are still the established stars. Earlier this year, the Topps NOW card marking Lewis Hamilton's first win for Ferrari, at the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix, became the highest-selling F1 Topps NOW card ever, with more than 50,000 copies printed.
